newsitem.title: UK: Boots shares drop after U.S. lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Boots shares drop after U.S. lawsuit.

text.p: Shares in British drug store group Boots Co Plc fell on Monday on news that it, Germany's BASF and its U.S. unit Knoll Pharmaceutical Co, were the target of a U.S. lawsuit, dealers said.
Boots shares, which hit a record 740p on May 14, were down 20-1/2p at 708 by 0906 GMT in volume of 1.9 million shares.

The $8.5 billion lawsuit, filed in the U.S. District Court in San Fancisco, alleged that they supressed a medical study that concluded that their thyroid drug was no better than cheaper, generic brands to treat people suffering from an under-active thyroid gland.
No-one at Boots was immediately available for comment.
